title: Dark Theme support with signature Circular Wave Animation (Antigravity-Manager style) using View Transitions API and Obsidian Dark Palette
commitMessage: style(theme): polish dark mode styling for modals and context submenus per L2 review
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Engineered system-wide Dark Theme support using Antigravity-Manager signature circular wave reveal animation powered by the View Transitions API and Obsidian Dark Palette (#090a0f, #0d1117, #161b22, #21262d, #f0f6fc). Implemented useThemeStore with localStorage caching, radial clip-path animation anchored to toggle button coordinates, and graceful fallback when View Transitions API is unavailable or prefers-reduced-motion is active. Propagated dark mode classes across 25 UI files covering Topbar, KanbanBoard, KanbanColumn, KanbanCard, CortexExplorer, AgentConsoleDrawer (activity stream, steer bar, diff sidebar, thinking card, tool cards), modals, and context menus. Resolved Level 2 review caveats by fully styling nested child controls (<select>, <input>) and submenus in secondary modals.
